Image 5: South Tyneside printing business secures six-figure funding

Cut Prints Solutions has received a six-figure investment

A South Tyneside-based printing business is scaling operations after receiving a six-figure investment, supporting its long-term goal to become a £1m turnover company. [...] The investment from the North East Elevate Fund, which is managed by FW Capital, will enable Cut Print Solutions to expand its operational capabilities with the acquisition of a next-generation Fuji EC1100 production printing press.
